reason: OME-1947 adds migration 0018_frozen_copy_retention, which adds the nullable columns claimed_at, swept_at and purged_at to frozen_copies. The test migrates to the newest migration, so the exact column set and the exact list of nullable columns of 0014 can no longer be true. The eight design columns of 0014 and their null rules are still asserted; the new columns are asserted in tests/unit/test_frozen_copy_retention_migration.py (S-28). Owner approvals in the session of 2026-11-17: the first assertion ('approved + change of the one existing test'), then the second assertion (answer 'Yes, limit to 0014 columns').
